Each project is written up as a case study: why I built it, how it works, which technologies I chose, and what I learned.

GeOlympic Games

Interactive web gamePrototype v0.5.6, playable online

Guess a city, an island or a sea from nothing but its real terrain. No labels, no names, just relief: a browser game that turns a topographic map into a recognition puzzle.

  • JavaScript
  • MapLibre GL JS
  • OpenTopoMap
  • MapTiler
  • QGIS
  • Natural Earth

GPX Combiner

Desktop app and QGIS pluginVersion 3.7.7, plugin 0.3.10 beta

Merge GPX tracks, pull activities out of Strava and push the result back. A local Python app packaged for macOS and Windows, with a companion QGIS plugin.

  • Python
  • Tkinter
  • Strava API
  • OAuth
  • PyQGIS
  • py2app
